title: General CET Strategy
content:
## MAH CET Exam Strategy

### Time Management
- Total time: 150 minutes for 200 questions
- Average time per question: 45 seconds
- Don't spend more than 90 seconds on any question

### Attempt Strategy
- No negative marking - attempt all questions
- Start with your strongest section
- Mark difficult questions and return later

### Exam Day Tips
- Reach the center 30 minutes early
- Carry valid ID proof and admit card
- Stay calm and focused
- Read each question carefully

title: Logical Reasoning Strategy
content:
## Logical Reasoning (75 Questions)

### Key Topics
- Syllogisms (High Priority)
- Blood Relations (High Priority)
- Seating Arrangement (High Priority)
- Coding-Decoding (High Priority)

### Approach
1. Start with simpler topics like Blood Relations
2. Leave complex arrangements for later
3. Use diagrams for seating arrangements
4. Practice Venn diagrams for syllogisms

### Common Mistakes
- Not reading all statements carefully
- Missing negative conditions
- Rushing through complex arrangements

title: Abstract Reasoning Strategy
content:
## Abstract Reasoning (25 Questions)

### Key Topics
- Figure Series (High Priority)
- Figure Analogy (High Priority)
- Pattern Completion (Medium Priority)

### Approach
1. Look for rotation patterns first
2. Check for addition/removal of elements
3. Observe shading patterns
4. Note size changes

### Tips
- Practice visual pattern recognition
- Time yourself during practice
- Don't overthink - trust your intuition

title: Quantitative Aptitude Strategy
content:
## Quantitative Aptitude (50 Questions)

### Key Topics
- Number System (High Priority)
- Percentage (High Priority)
- Profit & Loss (High Priority)
- Time & Work (High Priority)
- Data Interpretation (High Priority)

### Approach
1. Memorize formulas and shortcuts
2. Start with easier arithmetic questions
3. Leave complex DI for later
4. Use approximation for calculations

### Common Mistakes
- Calculation errors
- Not reading the question fully
- Missing units in answers

title: Verbal Ability & RC Strategy
content:
## VARC (50 Questions)

### Key Topics
- Reading Comprehension (High Priority)
- Para Jumbles (High Priority)
- Grammar (High Priority)
- Critical Reasoning (High Priority)

### Approach
1. Skim RC passages first, then read questions
2. Look for keywords in para jumbles
3. Eliminate obviously wrong options
4. Focus on author's tone and main idea

### Tips
- Build vocabulary through daily reading
- Practice identifying transition words
- Improve reading speed
